name: GeniusAI
rootCause: On May 5, 2024, GeniusAI lost about $1.27M after an attacker stole a team wallet private key via a Discord breach, minted 100 million fake GNUS tokens on Fantom, bridged them to Ethereum using Axelar, and sold them for ETH, draining the Uniswap liquidity pool. The exploit resulted from a compromised private key exposed in team Discord chats, enabling the attacker to deploy a counterfeit GNUS contract on Fantom and mint unbacked tokens. The Axelar bridge's deterministic address logic treated the new Fantom contract as legitimate, allowing the attacker to bridge these tokens to Ethereum and sell them for real assets.
